Alex R: Morning — quick async standup. TL;DR: fleet steady but EU prewarm short by 12 GPUs. Doing: validated autoscaler logs, filed ticket INF-482. Blockers: quota bump pending. Today: follow up on quota + CR review (pr #347).
Priya S: Did: finished region prewarm script, kicked AMI bake in eu-west-1. Blockers: cloud quota request still in progress (aws case 123456789). Today: will ping cloud infra and attach params to INF-482. @Alex R can you add required instance types? :thumbsup:
Alex R: Added instance list to INF-482, included g5.4xlarge and a1 options. Also left note for burst policy.
Jordan: Did: ran autoscaler e2e, found throttle spikes at 60k tokens/s — logs below:
```
[autoscaler] scale_event: reason=queue_spike target=+6 GPUs
[driver] api_err: rateLimitExceeded
```
Blocker: need rate-limit bump on dedicated pool for canary. Today: open PR for retry/backoff — pr: https://git/repo/pulls/356
infra-bot: notice — quota monitor: eu-west-1 GPU headroom at 8% (threshold 10%). Elevated alert created: QMON-2026
Marta: FYI I'm on call for the day. If we failover to us-west, I'll handle session routing. Q: any objections to temporarily increasing prefix cache TTL to reduce token load? @Jordan
Jordan: No objections. +1 from me, but let's monitor latency.
Priya S: I'll add TTL change to INF-482 as a mitigation step. ETA 30m.
Alex R: Ok — next steps: Priya follow cloud case, Jordan merge retry PR after tests, Marta watch routing. If quota bump not approved by EOD we start us-west burst plan. :raised_hands:
Marta: noted.
Alex R: closing loop — will post update here when cloud responds.
